episodeText:
USER: I've been sleeping poorly this week.
AGENT: Want to talk through what might be different?
USER: New baby — 6 weeks old. Up every 3 hours.
AGENT: That tracks. Any naps during the day?
USER: I try, but I'm working from home so I'm interrupted a lot.

expectedFacts.text: Sleep interrupted every 3 hours by the baby
Works from home with frequent interruptions
